I also host a few other sites for local clubs and such, but it's all Very low traffic/resource. I could probably run this stuff from my home to the same effect...

My primary issues have always been access to load what I want (and if you use the fairly standard cPanel and Softaculous, you'll have that 90% covered) and then the very rare need for customer service. Storage space was an issue once upon a time, but isn't today...
